data.research_question: Which public organizations matching the anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, mutual-aid and closely adjacent organization seed families can be defensibly enumerated from the next unresolved shard-B U.S. geographic area codes?
data.method: Dedicated area-code-hunt-v1-expanded pass; authoritative NANPA U.S. geographic-NPA gate; deterministic npa mod 3 sharding; literal 223/229/235 anarchist, anarchist-collective, ABC, Food Not Bombs and mutual-aid searches plus Harrisburg/Carlisle/Lancaster, Albany/Valdosta/southwest Georgia, and Columbia/central Missouri locality searches; first-party/public-hub/current-event review; repository dedupe; current-status checks; outward public-communications and operational-edge following. Reddit was used only as discovery/corroboration and not via an official API.
classification_rules: Only current authoritative U.S. geographic NPAs are eligible seeds; Canadian, Caribbean, service, reserved and planned-not-yet-in-service codes are excluded before sharding.
Shard B is NPA mod 3 == 1; completed 202, 205, 208, 214, 217 and 220 were not repeated.
Historical directories and stale accounts are discovery seeds only and are not promoted to active without current corroboration.
Anarchist labels are retained only when a source explicitly supports them; mutual-aid, abolitionist, LGBTQ-advocacy and food-sharing groups are not silently relabeled anarchist.
An operational edge into an area-code locality is preserved as such and does not make an outside organization a local chapter.
No individual political affiliation is inferred.

findings.notes: Food Not Bombs Harrisburg has independent current 2026 corroboration but no resolved current first-party hub. Food Not Bombs Carlisle is currently listed as nonhierarchical mutual aid. Lancaster County Chooses Love self-describes on its current first-party site as a mutual-aid organization.

Sol Underground is Atlanta-based. Its current public Hurricane Relief Fund explicitly states supply runs to/from Valdosta and surrounding cities, so the 229 relation is an operational edge, not a local-identity inference.
Both organizations have current first-party Columbia activity. COMAC explicitly self-describes its structure as mutual aid rather than charity.

Resolved exact social endpoints: Sol Underground Instagram, X/Twitter and Facebook; COMAC Facebook and Instagram. Sol Underground Linktree is recorded separately.
